# BrainCo Stark SDK installation directory

The pinned BrainCo Stark SDK files expected by the existing driver are included
in this directory. To refresh or repair them from the repository root:

```bash
bash src/hardware/brainco/revo2_driver/scripts/download_sdk.sh
```

The script installs the header and platform library below this directory. The
included and downloaded SDK files remain subject to BrainCo's terms; confirm
public redistribution permission before publishing or mirroring them.
